description: One Anthropic message whose usage includes cache read and cache write, traced by OpenInference.
notes: OpenInference records message content by default, and this scenario sets no content-capture environment variable. The system prompt is marked cache_control ephemeral. Scripted usage is input 2100, output 40, cache_read 1800, cache_write 200, so Anthropic's raw input_tokens is 100. The span's llm.token_count.prompt is 2100, with cache_read 1800 and cache_write 200 copied beside it: the instrumentor added the cache counts back. llm.finish_reason is end_turn on the span, not on the output message. Covers D110 (OpenInference input includes cache).
